paragraphs: We started Biryani House with a simple dream: to bring the authentic taste of traditional Indian biryani right here to Tabuk.
Every day we grind our spices fresh, select the finest basmati rice, and cook every dish with care. We never rush, because real biryani takes its time.
Today, we are proud to be part of the Tabuk community. We see families coming back to us every week, and that is the greatest recognition we could ask for.
